description: This file implements the React component 'EditorPage' which provides a rich text editor interface for creating and editing blog posts, including features like autosaving, publishing, deleting, and live subscription to post data using hooks. It also manages routing, slug generation, image uploads, and UI state feedback.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a callback function to delay execution until a specified delay period has passed without new calls.

methods.name: ensurePostId
methods.description: Ensures that the post has an ID, creating a new post if necessary, and navigates to the new URL if a post was created.

methods.name: debouncedSave
methods.description: Debounced function that autosaves the title and content of the post after a delay.

methods.name: handleUploadImage
methods.description: Handles image upload by calling the external upload image function and returning the URL.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Updates the content state and triggers autosave when the editor content changes.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Updates the title state and triggers autosave when the title input changes.

methods.name: handleManualSave
methods.description: Saves the current post manually when invoked.

methods.name: handleTogglePublish
methods.description: Toggles the published state of the post, updating slug if publishing.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current post after user confirmation and navigates back to dashboard.
